comments.body:
I'd like to discuss two topics:

1. Do we ship CFI'ed [EIP-7212](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7212) in Pectra? Differences between EIP & RIP (already in Polygon).
2. Can clients start removing support for [sunset](https://blog.ethereum.org/2023/11/30/goerli-lts-update) Görli? Can we remove Clique as well? Is it still used in Hive or any other tests? Do we need another announcement on https://blog.ethereum.org?
Same as @yperbasis - would like to discuss 7212 inclusion and precompile addresses and issues between RIP/Mainnet EIP

I'd like to suggest a change to the EIP-7002 and EIP-7251 contracts to improve traceability of el triggered operations for toolings (eg. explorers):
https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7002-execution-layer-triggerable-exits/14195/13
I'd like to talk about eip 158 deactivation https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8712

In #1081 we discussed this PR for 7702 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8677 and had positive feedback from the community and client teams. I would like to discuss on ACD and potentially accept this change for devnet-2.

> Can clients start removing support for [sunset](https://blog.ethereum.org/2023/11/30/goerli-lts-update) Görli?

Teku has already removed support for Goerli 👍
